# Expert-ordered scaled Q2 activation experiment

Derived within LIE from the retained scaled-wave-pack provider and independently
fetched official Gufo f783fedb9bea2ec7de941f6da4e02f4a4596b29e. Original MIT
notices remain. No sibling DS4 or CachyOS source/artifact is imported.

The generator copies the verified parent inventory, adds an expert-ordered
packing/down include and binds the eligible executor route after checking its
existing scratch capacity. Arithmetic, encoded weights, scalar decode and the
ordered downstream consumer remain unchanged. Source hashes, patch and parent
result are bound by config/q2-scaled-expert-order-source.json. Numerical and
performance acceptance are separate; no production/default promotion is made.
